description: Measure how long deals take to close and how often they are won. Send each deal's created date, outcome (won, lost or open), close date, and optionally its lead source and the last stage it reached, with your stage order. Get back days to close for won deals (count, median, quartiles and interquartile range, mean, sample standard deviation, shortest and longest), the win rate overall and by source (won / (won + lost)), and, with stages, the win rate of deals that reached each stage. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/sales-cycle-stats). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

closed.description: Close date for won and lost deals, YYYY-MM-DD (leave out for open deals).

created.description: Date the deal was created or qualified (whichever your cycle starts from), YYYY-MM-DD.

deal.description: Optional: your deal or opportunity code. Accepted so CRM rows can be sent as they are and checked for personal data; not used in the figures and not echoed.

source.description: Optional: lead source, e.g. 'referral' or 'paid search' (your own words; compared without regard to case).

stage.description: Optional: the last stage the deal reached (for a lost deal, the stage it was lost at). Must be one of stages. A won deal counts as reaching every stage.

label.description: Optional label, e.g. 'Q3 2026 mid-market' (your own text, echoed).

stages.description: Optional: your stage order, first to last (up to 20), e.g. ['Qualify', 'Demo', 'Proposal', 'Negotiate'].

items.description: Stage name, e.g. 'Demo' (your own words; compared without regard to case).
